scripts.test: npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.sidecar:package: node scripts/build-sidecar.mjs && node scripts/package-sidecar.mjs && node scripts/verify-sidecar.mjs
scripts.desktop:prepare: npm run build && npm run sidecar:package && node scripts/prepare-tauri-resources.mjs && npm run nsis:prepare
scripts.desktop:prepare:mac: npm run build && npm run sidecar:package && node scripts/prepare-tauri-resources.mjs
scripts.tauri:build: npm run desktop:prepare && node scripts/run-tauri.mjs build

scripts.tauri:build:mac: npm run desktop:prepare:mac && node scripts/verify-sidecar.mjs --mac && node scripts/run-tauri.mjs build --target aarch64-apple-darwin --bundles app,dmg && node scripts/verify-sidecar.mjs --packaged --mac
